description.en-US: Apps by Sovereign Edge Inc. for GrapheneOS and Pixel. Pocket Agent, a private on-device Claude agent; Pocket Pantry, a pantry, grocery cart and Claude recipes app; Pocket Concierge, an offline HTML itinerary viewer with Claude; and Pocket Coach, an open-source strength training app with spreadsheet plan import.

summary.en-US: Strength training programs, set logging, 1RM tracking and spreadsheet plan import

description.en-US:
Pocket Coach is an open-source strength and conditioning app in the spirit of TrainHeroic: a coach writes a program, the athlete follows it day by day, logs every set and watches their numbers move.

* Today: a week strip with the session your program puts on each day, one tap from starting
* Programs: weeks x days of sessions made of blocks (supersets) with per-set prescriptions as % of 1RM, RPE or a fixed load
* Workout logging with targets already turned into kilos or pounds, a rest timer and automatic estimated one-rep maxes
* Library of about 90 exercises plus your own, each with a 1RM, an e1RM chart and full history
* Progress: totals, a 12-week volume chart, records and history
* Import a training plan from a CSV or Excel spreadsheet, or a Pocket Coach program file; export programs to share with athletes

Everything stays on the phone: no account, no server, no analytics, and the app has no network permission.
